title: Oleng
mood: flirty and teasing, a settled couple showing off for each other
subject: a couple on a rented tandem bike at Jakarta's Sunday car-free day on Sudirman, she pedalling hard from the back, he steering badly from the front, stopping for ketoprak by the roundabout
caption: Indonesian pop R&B with a soul-pop lean. Rhodes electric piano voicing ninth and thirteenth chords with a soft tremolo, a muted single-note funk guitar answering the vocal in short licks, warm finger bass sliding into the downbeats, and laid-back drums with swung sixteenth hi-hats, a late rimshot and finger snaps on two and four, plus stacked background harmonies on the chorus. Warm, close and dry, the Rhodes and lead vocal forward, the low end soft and round. Smooth male lead moving between chest voice and falsetto, with short R&B runs at the ends of phrases and a few spoken asides. 86 BPM, E-flat major. Flirty and teasing, an easy Sunday-morning love song for a settled couple. No trap hi-hats, no rap verse, no autotune, no EDM drop, no acoustic guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and finger snaps]

[Verse 1]
Minggu pagi, jam enam, Sudirman tanpa mobil
Sewa sepeda tandem, tiga puluh ribu sejam
Kamu bilang, "Kamu yang setir, aku yang kuat"
Baru lima meter, kita hampir nabrak ondel-ondel

[Pre-Chorus]
Setangnya goyang, kamu ketawa di belakang
"Sayang, kiri dong! Kiri! Itu kiri yang lain!"

[Chorus]
Kamu yang gowes, aku yang oleng
Kakimu yang kerja, aku cuma pegang setang
Satu sepeda, dua orang, beda maunya
Tapi kalau jatuh, kita jatuhnya bareng

[Verse 2]
Bundaran HI, air mancurnya nyala
Kita minggir ke gerobak ketoprak biru
Kamu pesan cabe lima, aku cabe satu aja
Bumbu kacang nempel di dagumu, aku lap pakai jempol

[Chorus]
Kamu yang gowes, aku yang oleng
Kakimu yang kerja, aku cuma pegang setang
Satu sepeda, dua orang, beda maunya
Lima tahun kita begini, belum pernah jatuh juga

[Outro - Rhodes and falsetto ad-libs]
Jam sebelas, mobil udah mulai lewat lagi
Kiri, Sayang. Bukan, kiri yang lain.
